central_question: Can an adaptive system increase its future viability while remaining capable of incorporating justified correction?
core_rule: Never infer a downstream capability from an unvalidated upstream mechanism.

causal_composition_principle.statement: A downstream causal claim may not inherit authority from an upstream validated relation across a separable transformation unless that transformation is independently identified, prospectively specified and validated as an apparatus guarantee, or explicitly excluded from the claim.
causal_composition_principle.compression: validated endpoints do not imply a validated pathway
apparatus_guarantee_requires: independent validation or mechanical verification over the claimed domain

current_frontier.object: G1 warranted causal evidence control over a separable adaptive decision

conceptual_frontier.question: What must be true for a system to remain capable of incorporating warranted correction after a consequential modification?
conceptual_frontier.prerequisite_note: Any empirical repeated-correction claim remains blocked until its particular evidence-to-change pathway satisfies G1, direct G2 identification, and the CCA causal composition principle for every separable transformation it crosses.

maturity_ladder.name: measurement_validity
maturity_ladder.criterion: The intended G1 role is scientifically coherent and scoped; any empirical instantiation still requires a prospectively frozen measurement and treatment contract.

maturity_ladder.name: evidence_controlled_adaptive_decision
maturity_ladder.criterion: Prospectively admissible independently warranted evidence causally controls a separable adaptive decision in the warranted direction.

maturity_ladder.name: isolated_modification
maturity_ladder.criterion: Direct do(M=m) produces the warranted target effect while protected behavior remains within prospectively fixed tolerance.

maturity_ladder.name: evidence_to_justified_modification
maturity_ladder.criterion: G1 and direct G2 results may be composed into an end-to-end evidence-to-modification claim only when every additional separable transformation crossed by the claim is independently identified or prospectively specified and validated or verified as an apparatus relation.

maturity_ladder.name: extreme_adaptive_systems
maturity_ladder.note: AGI, recursive improvement, and ASI are stress-test regimes, not foundational objects.

G1.scientific_role: warranted evidence acquiring causal control over a separable adaptive decision

G1_G2_INTERMEDIATE_TRANSITION.required_when: the prospective architecture represents the adaptive decision and modification as separable causal variables and the scientific claim crosses their linkage
allowed_resolutions: prospectively specified and validated or verified apparatus guarantee

ECIM.architecture: E -> C_selected -> [architecture-dependent separable transformations] -> M -> (Y_T, Y_P)
fixed_design_principles: G2 is identified by independent direct do(M=m), not by conditioning on selected modifications.
Validated G1 and G2 endpoints do not establish an end-to-end pathway across an unvalidated separable transformation.
No universal bridge variable or G1.5 is assumed.

causal_boundaries: positive G1 and positive G2 do not imply a connected evidence-to-modification pathway
validated endpoints do not imply a validated pathway
G2 does not imply repeated correction
repeated correction does not imply justified transformability
justified transformability does not imply adaptive viability

forbidden_shortcuts: choose scientific object through benchmark convenience
repair a closed negative result under the same object identity
loosen a frozen gate after outcome
replace a policy-level estimand with a post-selected subset
infer capability or viability from upstream mechanism success
treat candidate selection as a universal architecture of correction
infer modification competence from selected or deployed modifications instead of direct do(M=m)
compose validated endpoints across an unvalidated separable transformation
treat deterministic apparatus plumbing as validated without prospective specification and validation or verification
invent an intermediate gate when the target architecture does not instantiate independently meaningful separable variables
